title: Issue-Age Share of the Universal Life Insurance Full-Surrender Charge
content:
On a full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, the share of the surrender charge that applies follows the insured's age last birthday on the issue date, counted from the insured's date of birth.

**Specification.** At or above issue age **65** (the older issue age) the older issue-age share of the charge applies, **80%** (0.80). At or above issue age **55** (the middle issue age) but below 65 the middle issue-age share applies, **90%** (0.90). Below issue age 55 the whole charge applies. The share multiplies the charge before it is rounded to the cent.

| Insured's age last birthday on the issue date | Share of the charge |
|---|---|
| 65 or over | 80% |
| 55 through 64 | 90% |
| Under 55 | Whole charge |

**Reading the age.** The age is worked out from the insured's date of birth and the issue date: the insured's age at the last birthday on or before the issue date.

**Hypothetical cases.**

| Insured's date of birth | Issue date | Age last birthday at issue | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May 1958 | 1 June 2023 | 65 | 80% |
| 10 July 1958 | 1 June 2023 | 64 | 90% |
| 2 June 1968 | 1 June 2023 | 54 | Whole charge |
| 1 June 1968 | 1 June 2023 | 55 | 90% |

A charge of $4000.0000 before the share becomes $3600.0000 at 90% and $3200.0000 at 80%.
